name: ethos-anonymous-reviews
title: Ethos Anonymous Reviews
description: Lets people who sign in with X leave a review of an Ethos profile without their name on it: the app posts the review onchain from its own wallet.

services.name: x-oauth
services.purpose: Sign in with X (OAuth 2.0) to prove the reviewer is a real account
services.notes: Client id and redirect URI are plain env vars (TWITTER_CLIENT_ID, TWITTER_REDIRECT_URI).

services.name: base-rpc
services.purpose: Sends the review transaction to the Ethos review contract on Base
services.notes: MAINNET_RPC_URL / TESTNET_RPC_URL are plain env vars (public Base RPCs by default). The posting wallet pays gas in ETH.

services.name: ethos-api
services.purpose: Profile search and reviewer score checks

services.name: discord
services.purpose: Posts a notification for each new review
services.notes: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL is a plain env var; ENABLE_DISCORD_NOTIFICATIONS turns it on.

secrets.name: MAINNET_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.from: Private key of the app's posting wallet on Base mainnet (team password manager); keep it funded with a little ETH for gas

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.from: Random string of at least 32 characters (openssl rand -base64 48)

secrets.name: TESTNET_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.from: Private key of a Base Sepolia wallet; only read when BLOCKCHAIN_NETWORK=testnet

secrets.name: TWITTER_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.from: X developer portal → the app → Keys and tokens → OAuth 2.0 Client Secret

notes: Fresh app on Deno Deploy (project ethos). BLOCKCHAIN_NETWORK (plain var) picks mainnet or testnet; the contract address and RPC per network are plain vars too. Every review is signed by the app wallet, so its ETH balance is the only running cost. Privacy knobs (DISABLE_ALL_LOGS, ANONYMIZE_USER_IDS, ANONYMIZATION_SALT, REDACT_SENSITIVE_DATA) are optional; see PRIVACY_GUIDE.md.
